## The premise

What the player does, what makes it hard, and what counts as success.

## Controls and capabilities

Include unsupported/denied behavior for anything permission-gated.

## Similarity check

Date, accepted commit and open PRs checked (including drafts, with pagination). Closest matches and meaningful differences. Note any missing access.

## Evidence

- Checks run and actual results:
- Light/dark and mobile:
- Success/reset/cleanup/exit/mute:
- Bypass pass and retest:
- Human playtest feedback, or explicit waiver:
- Preview URL/status (pending is fine; don't invent one):

## Before review

- [ ] Changes stay in my submission directory, or shared changes are explicitly called out.
- [ ] Hard rules and dependency policy checked.
- [ ] No secrets, player uploads, tracking or required external site.
- [ ] Success is achievable and cleanup works.
